meta.title: Vault Tab
meta.description: Adds a right-sidebar Vault tab: a file tree of a configured folder with native previews. Also gives a session the vault tools: vault_search and vault_read for grep-first retrieval (names and summaries, reference excluded), vault_note, vault_write, vault_move and vault_delete for writing, gated per session by a Vault Grant in the composer and linted against the vault's POLICY.md. An optional vault-setup skill creates or adopts that folder; switch it off once the vault exists.
